# Primo Toys

> Primo Toys creates screen-free coding robots and educational toys that teach foundational programming concepts to young children through hands-on, Montessori-inspired play.

Primo Toys specializes in Cubetto and Cubetto+, award-winning coding robots designed for children ages 3+. The company provides comprehensive educational resources, classroom curricula, and adventure packs to support early years STEM learning without screens.

## Key Topics

- Cubetto robot
- Cubetto+
- Screen-free learning
- Coding toys
- Early years education
